purpose.seed: Repeatable authored grain, pores and scene placement; independent of gameplay RNG.
purpose.source_burial_m: Retains B1 source ground seating before the C3 metre transform.
purpose.vertical_scale: Raises the full crown above the existing 4.5 m trunk envelope.
purpose.body_radius_m: Keeps lower wood inside the native 0.805 m square at every yaw with a small margin.
purpose.crown_start_m: Height above the native body where branches can begin broadening.
purpose.crown_full_m: Smoothly restores the inherited full crown width by this height.
purpose.scar_depth_m: Cuts new physical root/trunk damage after fitting, so the narrowing cannot erase depth.
purpose.lod_m: Study distance transitions to simpler crown and bark geometry; discrete, no crossfade.
purpose.deadfall: Fits the separate native finite bark deposit. Three removable bark sleeves expose the lighter core as 18, 12 and 6 units remain; 11 mm pits provide actual cork porosity.
purpose.wind_tip_m: Maximum leaf-tip movement with stationary attached petioles.
purpose.wind_period_s: Slow cosmetic crown motion, paused by the explicit review clock.
purpose.pulse_period_s: Ambient altered-host life, independent of harvesting or success.
purpose.peak_emission: Restrained warm energy in physical wounds without a scar lamp or bloom.
purpose.minimum_light: Faint visible life between peaks; ordinary hosts and recovered material remain unlit.
